description:
A gas station attendant in Vermont dies at 92. That's the core of The Psychology of Money by Morgan Housel — and it's not what you'd expect.

In this deep dive into "The Psychology of Money" by Morgan Housel, we break down every key idea in plain language — the arguments, the turning points, and what they mean for the way you think and decide. By the end you'll walk away with the book's biggest takeaways and one reframing you can actually use. No fluff, no ending spoilers.
